results.title: MyExpatTaxes vs Expatfile: Which Expat Tax Software Is Right for You?
results.snippet: Some taxpayers may also need to file Form 8938 under the Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) if they meet higher asset thresholds. Based on publicly available pricing information, Expatfile provides FBAR instructions by email within its Standard Plan, offers full FBAR filing support as an additional service, and limits FATCA reporting to its Investor-tier plan. By contrast, MyExpatTaxes includes full FBAR filing support, enabling expats to e-file FinCEN Form 114 with the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) at the same time they file their tax return.
